article_1.title: Black Mold
article_1.description: Black mold commonly develops in areas with high levels of moisture.
article_1.recommended_action: Inspect the affected area and remove the source of moisture.

article_2.title: False Outlet
article_2.description: False outlets resemble ordinary electrical sockets but may indicate an unusual presence inside the wall.
article_2.recommended_action: Do not touch or remove the outlet. Contact a qualified inspector.

article_3.title: Ceiling Dweller
article_3.description: Ceiling dwellers usually inhabit attics and enclosed spaces above occupied rooms.
article_3.recommended_action: Leave the room and restrict access to the affected area.
